ios.desc:
Beadora turns photos, text prompts, blank canvases, and Gallery templates into fuse-bead and diamond-painting patterns.

Create a pattern from a photo with a separate one-time photo-conversion purchase, generate an original idea with one AI-generation purchase, draw freely on a blank canvas, or unlock locked Gallery content with either a single-pattern purchase or a whole-style purchase. A whole-style purchase permanently unlocks every current and future pattern in the selected style. Some Gallery patterns are free. Template reduction is free and unlimited.

Key Features:
- Convert one photo into a fuse-bead or diamond-painting grid on device
- Generate one pattern from a text prompt with a separate AI purchase
- Draw manually on a blank canvas
- Browse, search, and customize Gallery patterns
- Unlock locked Gallery patterns individually or by style; a style unlock includes future additions to that style
- Reduce an existing template for free, with no usage limit
- Use Universal 291, Perler, Universal 221, and Artkal S fuse-bead palettes
- Use the complete DMC 447 palette for diamond painting
- Choose preset or custom grid sizes
- Preview numbered grids with color codes and piece counts
- Preview patterns as rotatable, zoomable 3D finished pieces, keychains, desk decorations, or bag charms
- Save projects and export or share pattern images

Photo conversion and template reduction are processed on device. No account sign-in is required.
